title: Reverse a Number
problemStatement: Reverse the digits of an integer. Discuss overflow if the reversed value must fit 32-bit.
intuition: Pop digits with %10 and push into ans = ans*10 + digit. In fixed-width languages, check overflow before multiplying.

approaches.title: Digit peel (Python — unbounded ints)
approaches.idea: Python ints do not overflow; still show the overflow check interviewers expect in Java/C++.
approaches.code:
def reverse_number(n: int) -> int:
    sign = -1 if n < 0 else 1
    n = abs(n)
    ans = 0
    while n:
        ans = ans * 10 + n % 10
        n //= 10
    return sign * ans

# Java/C++ interview variant must guard 32-bit overflow before ans*10

followUps: Reverse only a portion of digits?
interviewInsight: Overflow handling on reverse is a favorite Java follow-up.
